title: A Contract-Grade Verifier for LLM-Generated GPU Kernels, and a Native Blackwell Backward for the Gated-Linear-Recurrence Family
abstract: arXiv:2608.12700v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Systems that generate GPU kernels with language models report high correctness rates. Those rates come from a single loose test: run the kernel on a few random inputs at one fixed shape and accept it if the output is close to a reference. A kernel can pass that test and still be silently wrong. It can return an ordinary number where the true answer is a NaN or an infinity, differ from run to run, break when the shape changes, or accumulate in fp16 where the reference keeps an fp32 total. We build the instrument that checks correctness properly: a contract-grade verifier of twelve adversarial gates, each a property a correct kernel must satisfy, several of them tolerance-free, so no choice of threshold can explain a failure away. Aimed outward, the verifier audits 2,638 machine-generated kernels that a public system's own harness had already accepted as correct. translated_title: 针对大语言模型生成的GPU内核的合同级验证器，以及门控线性递归系列的原生Blackwell反向传播
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.12700v1 公告类型：新 摘要：使用语言模型生成GPU内核的系统报告了较高的正确率。这些比率来自一个单一的宽松测试：在内核上以固定形状运行几个随机输入，如果输出接近参考值则接受。内核可以通过该测试但仍可能静默出错。它可能在真实答案是NaN或无穷大时返回一个普通数字，运行间结果不同，形状变化时出错，或在fp16中累积而参考值保持fp32总和。我们构建了正确检查的工具：一个由十二个对抗性门组成的合同级验证器，每个门都是正确内核必须满足的属性，其中几个是无容差的，因此没有阈值选择可以解释失败。向外看，验证器审计了2,638个机器生成的内核，这些内核已被公共系统自己的测试框架接受为正确。它发现39.5%的内核无论任何容差论证都是损坏的，62.1%的内核至少携带一个可疑行为。
tldr: 本文提出一个合同级验证器，通过十二个对抗性门严格检查GPU内核的正确性，发现大量已通过传统测试的机器生成内核存在隐藏缺陷。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a contract-grade verifier with twelve adversarial gates to rigorously check GPU kernel correctness, revealing that many machine-generated kernels passing conventional tests harbor hidden flaws.
